"'''How Do They See, Anyway? (Stormtrooper's Dilemma)'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] by the band [[Deeply Religious]] from their album ''[[Advanced Explosives Handbook]]''. It was banned by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].
